reviewer: aduth
threshold: 0.01
---

Does this change how a component, a design token or a Sass mixin of the design system packages `@wordpress/components`, `@wordpress/ui`, `@wordpress/theme`, `@wordpress/base-styles` or `@wordpress/icons` looks or behaves for the people who use it, for example its styles, its interactions or its accessibility? Only changes to these packages count, not changes to application code that uses them. Answer no when what people see and do stays the same, such as for a refactor, or for a change to dependencies, tooling, tests, types or build configuration that keeps the same runtime behavior.
